name: Aadhaar Card
description: Unique 12-digit identity number issued by UIDAI for Indian citizens.
why_required: Used for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) and primary identity verification across government portals.
how_to_obtain: Visit any Aadhaar Seva Kendra or approved bank/post office enrollment center.

name: Income Certificate
description: Official government document certifying annual family income.
why_required: Required to prove eligibility for welfare schemes with income caps.
how_to_obtain: Apply through your state e-District portal or Tehsildar office.
issuing_authority: Revenue Department / Tehsildar of respective State/UT

name: Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC)
description: Official document confirming belonging to SC, ST, or OBC category.
why_required: Required for targeted reservation benefits, fee waivers, and specific financial support schemes.
how_to_obtain: Apply online via state e-District portal or offline at Revenue Office.

name: Bank Account Passbook / Cancelled Cheque
description: Aadhaar-seeded bank account details for direct fund transfer.
why_required: Enables direct cash benefit transfer (DBT) without intermediaries.
how_to_obtain: Open account at any public/private bank or India Post Payments Bank (IPPB).
issuing_authority: Scheduled Commercial Bank / Reserve Bank of India

name: Domicile / Residence Certificate
description: Proof that applicant is a permanent resident of a specific State or Union Territory.
why_required: Required for state-specific government welfare schemes.
how_to_obtain: Apply via State e-Services / e-District portal with address proof.

name: Land Records (RoR / Khasra / Khatauni)
why_required: Mandatory for farmer income support, crop insurance, and agricultural credit schemes.
how_to_obtain: Download online from state land records portal (e.g., Bhulekh) or Tehsil.

name: Ration Card (NFSA / BPL / AAY)
description: Official card issued for subsidized foodgrains under National Food Security Act.
why_required: Establishes food security and low-income status.
how_to_obtain: Apply through State Food & Civil Supplies Department.
issuing_authority: Department of Food & Public Distribution / State Civil Supplies

name: Artisan / Craftsperson Certificate
description: Official ID or certificate verifying traditional craft/artisan trade.
why_required: Required for toolkit incentives, credit support, and skill upgrade.
how_to_obtain: Register on PM Vishwakarma portal or Development Commissioner (Handicrafts).
issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
